nodes.description: _totalShares: total shares of all payees, used as divisor in release() and tokenRescue()
_totalReleased: cumulative Ether already released to payees
_shares: mapping(address => uint256) holding each payee's shares
_released: mapping(address => uint256) of Ether already paid to a payee
_payees: dynamic array of payee addresses iterated by tokenRescue()
PaymentSplitter constructor: validates payees/shares arrays then calls _addPayee for each entry
receive() external payable: emits PaymentReceived(_msgSender(), msg.value)
totalShares() public view getter returning _totalShares
totalReleased() public view getter returning _totalReleased
shares(address) public view getter returning _shares[account]
released(address) public view getter returning _released[account]
payee(uint256) public view getter returning _payees[index]
release(address payable): computes payment, updates _released/_totalReleased, then sends Ether via Address.sendValue
_addPayee(address,uint256) private: registers payee, sets shares, increments _totalShares
tokenRescue(IERC20) public: shareholder-only loop distributing the contract's token balance to all payees
tokenTransfer(IERC20,address,uint256) private: wraps token.safeTransfer
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) internal library helper performing a low-level call{value:}
SafeERC20.safeTransfer library helper performing an external token call via Address.functionCall
